description: Patrick Flynn's FamilySearch hints (LZNY-BRF), pending matches only: the 1860 census (confidence 3) and the 1908 death certificate (confidence 2). Keyed on status ["pending"] so only a hints-list call matches it; list it BEFORE person-record-matches-flynn, whose args {id} also match a pending call and whose response mixes in the ACCEPTED 1850 census. A call with no status therefore gets the mixed list, and a hint review that surfaces the accepted match fails (issue #2029).
